title: Here’s some background behind the vintage baseball glove a Red Sox fan gave to Aroldis Chapman
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: A Red Sox fan gifted Aroldis Chapman a vintage Bob Feller model glove from the 1930s during a game.
Chapman, despite receiving the glove, allowed a two-run homer but the Red Sox won the game 12-11 in 13 innings.
The Red Sox begin a three-game series against the Athletics at Fenway Park following their win over the White Sox.

title: K-pop superstars BTS prepped for their Gillette shows at Planet Fitness in Downtown Crossing, apparently
author: Peter Chianca
bullets: BTS members Jung Hoseok, Kim Taehyung, and Jung Kook were seen working out at Planet Fitness in Downtown Crossing.
Jung Kook documented their visit to the Boston gym on Instagram, surprising local members and fans.
BTS recently performed two sold-out shows at Gillette Stadium, reportedly earning more than Taylor Swift this year.

title: Meet Marty: Cape Cod’s newest great white shark is sticking around
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Marty, a 10-foot great white shark, is the Atlantic White Shark Conservancy's first identified shark of 2026.
Marty, named after Stop & Shop's robot, has been detected 15 times off North Truro since July 16.
The data from Marty's tag aids research on shark behavior and supports conservation off Cape Cod.

title: 5 restaurants we can’t wait to try in August
author: Jillian Dara
bullets: About Thyme, a Lebanese bakery, opens in Cambridge, offering Middle Eastern dishes like sumac chicken wraps and labneh yogurt.
Nana's Green Tea debuts in Boston, featuring Tokyo-inspired matcha drinks and desserts, including mochi parfaits and matcha cakes.
Tom Yum Yang, a Thai BBQ eatery in Allston, introduces dishes like Tong Pen tacos and Hor Mok Yang curry souffle.

title: Boston University joins growing list of colleges expanding financial aid
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Boston University will cap annual costs at $20,000 for first-year students from families earning under $200,000.
Families earning $75,000 or less will attend Boston University with no cost under the new financial aid plan.
The initiative includes loan-free need-based aid and follows a trend of private schools expanding financial aid.

title: Mass. medical delivery worker charged after allegedly assaulting woman in wheelchair
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Qaisar Ali, 39, was arrested by East Bridgewater Police for allegedly assaulting a woman in a wheelchair during a medicine delivery.
Ali faces multiple charges, including assault and battery and indecent exposure, after entering the victim's home without consent.
Ali’s arrest followed an investigation identifying him and his vehicle, leading to a motor vehicle stop and $10,000 bail.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial closes out second week after friends and former father-in-law testify
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's trial ends its second week with testimony from friends and her former father-in-law in Plymouth Superior Court.
Lindsay Clancy is using an insanity defense, claiming postpartum mental illness led to the deaths of her three children.
Testimonies describe Clancy as a caring mother struggling with mental health issues following the birth of her third child.

title: 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory
author: Trevor Hass
bullets: Red Sox beat White Sox 12-11 in 13 innings, marking their 8th consecutive victory on Thursday night at Fenway Park.
Caleb Durbin's walk-off single capped Boston's win after five comebacks, helping him earn praise for his consistent performance.
Boston Red Sox are now a season-high 12 games over .500, having won 26 of their last 29 games.

title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are standout performers at Patriots training camp, impressing both coaches and teammates.
Dre'Mont Jones and Andy Borregales are among those improving their stock, showcasing strong performances in practice.
Kyle Williams and Caleb Lomu have seen their practice roles diminish, with struggles impacting their standing on the depth chart.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias is batting .326 with 12 RBI in his first 10 Triple-A games with Worcester Red Sox.
Red Sox prospect Franklin Arias could be called up due to injuries to Trevor Story and others.
Red Sox officials emphasize development over immediate promotion for 20-year-old prospect Franklin Arias.
